bias: Assistant implemented the pipeline and previously saw aggregate results and some failures. Scores and automatic evidence-hit flags are omitted from the audit case view; review is not fully blinded.
coherence_sampling: First ten prepared PDF page IDs sorted ascending; midpoint character adjusted forward over whitespace; earliest-starting chunk that contains that location. Identical B/C chunks receive identical labels.

coherence_scale.0: Fragmented or missing subject/context so the local idea cannot be understood
coherence_scale.1: Partly understandable but cut boundaries or missing context prevent a complete standalone idea
coherence_scale.2: Subject/action and complete local idea are understandable within the chunk

grounding_sampling.original_test: All five original test questions q16-q20, same questions for A/B/C
grounding_sampling.fresh_test_subset: First five fresh holdout IDs h01-h05, same questions for C/F; supplementary comparison only

grounding_scale.1: Relevant partial evidence but a required fact, condition, identity, or link is missing
grounding_scale.2: Top-three passages jointly contain sufficient evidence and conditions to answer with source traceability

grounding_policy: Review actual top-three text independently of strict full-quote scores. Multiple chunks and valid alternative source pages may jointly support an answer. Do not invent unavailable facts or assume missing conditions.
metadata_checks: document_id/source identify the actual local PDF
physical page number and passage text match original PDF extraction
section matches verified PDF contents/section opening pages
character offsets match unchanged prepared page
explicit filter compliance checked separately from field correctness
limitations: First-ten-page coherence sample emphasizes early scenes
Only five grounding questions per strategy/cohort
Local file paths require a manifest/access instructions for another computer
